items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) $2b Share Sale
items.summary: Keurig Dr Pepper completed a US$2b follow on equity offering of about 57,971,015 common shares at US$34.50 each, with proceeds allocated to repaying or repurchasing outstanding debt ahead of a planned split into two listed companies. The move shifts part of the capital structure from borrowings to equity, which affects leverage targets, earnings per share calculations, and flexibility for the upcoming Beverage Co and Global Coffee Co separation.
